policy: Synod: SynodSpec uses a temporal-exists (\EE) TLC cannot check directly. Hand-built MC_Synod wrapper calls the base modules own top-level IS(chosen,allInput) instance-parameterization with concrete (non-hidden) variables. Exposed two genuine corpus defects in Synod.tla itself, fixed in corpus/configs/patches/50.tla (see PATCHES.md): an unbounded CHOOSE for NotAnInput, and a missing prime in IFail leaving allInput unconstrained.

MultiPaxos: base module defines no invariant/property of its own by design -- TypeOK/Linearizability live in MultiPaxos_MC (spec 146). Reuses spec 146s wrapper, same sibling-corpus-spec pattern as specs 90/92, 12/14, 35/36, 47/48. Draft cfg already used a smaller Writes set (1 vs spec 146s 2) -- worth trying since spec 146 itself is confirmed genuinely large.
